article.headline: Andrew Alekseyenko scores 18, Colgate takes down Hofstra 75-49
article.description: — Andrew Alekseyenko scored 18 points as Colgate beat Hofstra 75-49 on Friday.
article.linkText: Andrew Alekseyenko scores 18, Colgate takes down Hofstra 75-49
article.story: HEMPSTEAD, N.Y. -- — Andrew Alekseyenko scored 18 points as Colgate beat Hofstra 75-49 on Friday. Sam Wright added 15 points and six rebounds while shooting 7 for 13, including 1 for 5 from beyond the arc for the Raiders (3-4). . Parker Jones shot 4 for 6, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc to finish with 10 points. Justin Moore led the Pride (2-4) in scoring, finishing with 17 points and two steals. Hofstra also got 11 points from Tanner Thomas. Joshua DeCady finished with five points. Colgate took the lead for good almost 2 1/2 minutes into the game and led m41-23 at halftime, with Alekseyenko racking up nine points. Colgate outscored Hofstra by eight points over the final half, while Wright led the way with a team-high 10 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
